set.body: Selected 1.0 path: no public laws kit is published. Acceptance criteria: ravel-laws remains publish-skipped on JVM and Scala.js; its Compile output contains no ravel.laws API classes; publication manifests and local snapshot commands include core only; docs explicitly direct downstream users to core rather than a laws coordinate; JVM/Scala.js test code still exercises the internal generated suite; and the abandoned adapter/RuleSet compatibility promise is recorded as a future decision rather than implied by empty consumer proof.
set.title: Verify the internal laws module exposes no downstream artifact contract
